title: Educates training-platform umbrella chart values
description: Validates the umbrella chart's own values: subchart toggles and the cross-cutting `global:` block. Each subchart's `.Values.<subchart>` is validated independently by that subchart's own values.schema.json — this schema treats subchart blocks as opaque objects to avoid duplication.

secretRef.description: Reference to a Kubernetes Secret. Empty `name` means the ref is unset.

kyvernoLegacyClusterPolicy.description: A legacy Kyverno ClusterPolicy resource (kyverno.io). Open shape; only top-level identity is validated.

kyvernoNewPolicy.description: A Kyverno policy resource from the policies.kyverno.io group: ValidatingPolicy, MutatingPolicy, GeneratingPolicy or DeletingPolicy. Open shape; only top-level identity is validated.

kyvernoClusterAdditionalPolicy.description: A policy accepted by clusterSecurity.additionalKyvernoPolicies: a legacy ClusterPolicy (kyverno.io) or any policies.kyverno.io type (ValidatingPolicy, MutatingPolicy, GeneratingPolicy, DeletingPolicy). Applied verbatim by the chart.

global.description: Cross-cutting values that propagate to every subchart as `.Values.global.<key>`. Subcharts deep-merge their local block under the matching `global.<key>`, with globals winning per-leaf where set.

development.description: Local-development overrides. Leave empty in normal use — Chart.yaml annotations on each subchart provide the publish-time defaults for image refs.

clusterIngress.description: Cluster-wide ingress identity. Consumed by session-manager (operator config + auto-derived SecretCopier + CA Secret mount, appended to the image's CA bundle), lookup-service (Ingress TLS + CA Secret mount, read by the service itself + SecretCopier), and node-ca-injector (CA Secret mount + SecretCopier).

clusterSecurity.description: Cluster-level security policy enforcement. Drives Kyverno cluster-policy rendering in session-manager, the Kyverno workshop-policy feed, and SCC ClusterRoleBindings in session-manager and secrets-manager.

lookup-service.description: lookup-service subchart values. Validated by charts/lookup-service/values.schema.json.

remote-access.description: remote-access subchart values. Validated by charts/remote-access/values.schema.json.
